resources.string: Open gocast on your PC and join the same Wi-Fi. Scan its QR with your phone, or choose Find on Wi-Fi and enter the pairing code.
Android asks before sharing starts. Stop from the app, its notification, or your PC. If sharing pauses, tap Resume.
Choose Smooth, Balanced or Sharp in Quality settings. Fine-tune resolution, frame rate and bitrate, then save your own profiles. Changes save automatically.
Try stopping this preview. It does not start or stop a real cast.
Try a preset here. This preview leaves your saved quality settings unchanged.
